        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        if (L % 2 == 1) {
            pw.println(all);
            pw.close();
            return;
        }

        ifac[L] = power(fac[L], P - 2);
        for (int i = L; i >= 1; i--) {
            ifac[i - 1] = (long) ifac[i] * i % P;
        }

                if (i >> j & 1) {

                }
            }
            suma[bitcnt[i]][i] = ifac[s];
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
            int i, j, k, l;
            long[] a = suma[t];
            for (l = m; l >= 2; l >>= 1) {
                for (j = 0; j < m; j += l) {
                    for (k = 0; k < l / 2; k++) {
                        a[j + k + l / 2] = (a[j + k + l / 2] + a[j + k]) % P;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                a[j] = a[j] % P;
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
            System.arraycopy(suma[t], 0, dp[t], 0, m);
        }

        int cc = 0, revK = 0;
        while (K > 0) {
            revK = (revK << 1) | (K & 1);
            cc++;
            K >>= 1;
        }
        for (cc--; cc > 0; cc--, revK >>= 1) {
            for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {

            }
            for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {

                    long[] f = tmp[a + b];
                    long[] g = dp[a];
                    long[] h = suma[b];
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                        f[j] = (f[j] + g[j] * h[j]) % P;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
                System.arraycopy(tmp[t], 0, dp[t], 0, m);
            }

            if (revK % 2 == 1) {
                for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
                    Arrays.fill(tmp[t], 0);
                }
                for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {

    static long power(long a, int t) {
        long r = 1;
        while (t > 0) {
